description: Three-roads planning protocol for trios macOS app. Every task picks a road based on urgency, risk, and depth.

A.name: Fastest Road — Hotfix
criteria: App won't launch or critical feature broken
Risk of data loss or security issue
process: Observe: read experience.md for similar bug
examples: Chat input completely non-functional → NSTextView fix
Build broken after merge → swiftc error fix

B.name: Balanced Road — Feature / Bugfix
criteria: Needs UI verification but not full redesign
process: Observe: read experience.md + check related issues
Plan: break into subtasks, pick agents by domain
TDD: define build + e2e criteria before code
Delegate: spawn 2-3 agents in sequence or parallel
examples: Add new settings tab → UI + ViewModel + persistence
Fix auto-scroll for long conversations → scroll math
Improve message bubble styling → BR-OUTPUT changes

C.name: Deep Road — Architecture / Protocol
process: Observe: full audit of affected rings + read AGENTS.md
Plan: spec-first — write agent instructions before code
TDD: define ring-level contracts, build + e2e + anomaly checklist
Delegate: spawn agents per ring (A for arch, H for UI, X for MCP)
Learn: save detailed episode + update baselines
examples: Replace SR-01 transport layer → SSE → WebSocket migration
Add new ring SR-04 for AI model management
Implement Trinity 27-agent swarm in UI → full alphabet activation
